text: # Call Transcript: Postpaid Account Closure Request **Document ID:** TRX_008 **Category:** C21 — Termination & Deactivation **Department:** Customer Care **Customer Scope:** all **Last Updated:** 2026-06-12 **Version:** 1.0 **Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base **Channel:** Voice (Call Centre) --- ## Conversation Agent: NovaTel Customer Care, this is Vivek. Customer: I'd like to close my postpaid connection. Agent: I can help with that. May I ask the reason, in case there's something we can resolve first? Customer: I'm relocating abroad permanently. Agent: Understood. Before closure, you'll need to clear any outstanding dues — I see your current balance is ₹0, so you're clear. I'll process the closure request now; your final bill will be generated within 5-7 working days for any pro-rated charges. Customer: Will I get my number back if I return? Agent: The number enters a cooling-off period after closure and may be reassigned after that, so it's not guaranteed. I'll note your request; is there anything else? Customer: No, that's all, thank you. Agent: I've also gone ahead and added a note on your account so if you contact us again about this, the team will have full context. Customer: Great, appreciate it. Agent: You're welcome — is there anything else I can help with today? Customer: No, that's everything. ## Diagnostic Notes (Internal) - Identity verified via registered number and OTP. - Relevant backend status checked before providing resolution timeline. - Case closed after customer confirmation; escalated only if unresolved beyond the stated SLA. ## Escalation This case was
